description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget class 'MenuProvider' which manages menu categories and items, with offline caching and analytics integration. It provides methods to load menu data, seed demo data, retrieve items by category or ID, and maintains state for loading and error conditions.

classes.name: MenuProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that provides menu categories and items, handles offline caching, and logs analytics events.

methods.name: MenuProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing cache and analytics services.

methods.name: loadMenu
methods.description: Loads menu data, first trying offline cache, then seeding demo data if cache is empty, and logs an event if 'initial' is true.

methods.name: itemsByCategory
methods.description: Returns a list of MenuItems filtered by the provided category ID.

methods.name: itemById
methods.description: Retrieves a MenuItem by its ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: _seedDemoMenu
methods.description: Populates the provider with demo menu categories and items.
